title: Electrical impedance spectroscopy of plant cells in aqueous buffer media over a wide frequency range of 4 Hz to 20 GHz
author: Kadan-Jamal, Sophocleous, et al.

steps.title: Deep clean probe components
steps.instruction: Perform the initial deep cleaning of all probe parts before the first experiment and then clean them with IPA and nitrogen before and after each measurement.

substeps.instruction: Clean the brass casing of the low‑frequency probe and the stainless‑steel parts of both probes in an aqueous solution of 12 g L⁻¹ sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) and 1 M NaOH at boiling temperature for 8 min.
Rinse the metal parts for a few minutes in hot deionized water followed by cold deionized water.
Submerge the Teflon parts in Piranha solution (H₂SO₄·H₂O₂, 3:1). The exothermic reaction raises the temperature to ~85 °C; maintain this temperature for 20 min, then clean with soap and a scrubber.
For routine cleaning before and after each measurement, wash all parts with isopropanol (IPA) and deionized water, then dry with a nitrogen gas flow.

steps.title: Grow tomato cell cultures
steps.instruction: Maintain tomato (S. lycopersicum cv Mill.; line MSK8) suspension cultures in defined Murashige and Skoog (MS) medium under the specified conditions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare MS medium supplemented with vitamins (Duchefa Biochemie), 30 g L⁻¹ sucrose, 1 mg L⁻¹ 2,4‑dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4‑D), and 0.1 mg L⁻¹ kinetin; adjust pH to 5.7.
Incubate the cultures at 25 °C in the dark while gently rotating at approximately 100 rpm.
Sub‑culture the cells every two weeks; use cells that are 14–20 days post‑sub‑culture for experiments.

steps.title: Standardize cell concentration
steps.instruction: Obtain a concentrated cell suspension of known density from the cultured cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the harvested cells at 1500 rpm for 5 min at room temperature.
Decant the supernatant and resuspend the pellet to achieve a concentration of approximately 1.7 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ (defined as the 100 % stock solution).

steps.title: Prepare diluted cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Create a series of cell suspensions with defined percentages of the concentrated stock.

substeps.instruction: Mix the 100 % concentrated suspension with fresh MS medium to obtain the desired dilution (e.g., 50 % suspension = equal volumes of concentrated stock and fresh medium).
Label each dilution according to its percentage of the concentrated stock.

steps.title: Extract equivalent circuit parameters
steps.instruction: Process the impedance data to obtain the circuit parameters that describe the cells and media only.

substeps.instruction: Fit the raw measured impedance spectra to the full circuit model that includes cells, media, and parasitic elements.
Compensate for geometrical differences by stitching together spectra from the different frequency ranges.
Fit the geometry‑compensated spectra to the unified model containing only the cell and media components to extract the final equivalent‑circuit parameters.
